authority_note: Phase-6 contract artifact for static validation. It is NOT runtime database authority, NOT a migration, and NOT knowledge authority. Knowledge authority remains Git + immutable bundle (ADR-0004/0013). This JSON file is the maintained source artifact; the scratch generator used during initial authoring is not required. Hand edits must pass the JSON Schema, validate_data_contract.py (including its negative mutations), the CI self-test and the canonical gate.

database.baseline_note: PostgreSQL 16 is the SRS-001 §2.4 environment baseline; no extension is required by this contract.

conventions.naming: snake_case; singular table nouns; primary key <table>_id; *_at timestamptz instants; *_sha256 / *_digest lowercase hex SHA-256; *_ref opaque external references

identifier.text_form: lowercase canonical hyphenated (36 chars; satisfies the governed identifier shape)

canonical_json.definition: knowledge/ai/governance.py canonical_json: sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii, allow_nan=False, UTF-8

conventions.on_delete: RESTRICT only; ON DELETE CASCADE is forbidden

tenancy.note: No tenant column is added. ASM-002 (single tenancy) is UNCONFIRMED. It does not block acceptance of this versioned persistence contract because the five tenancy-sensitive structures are explicitly PROVISIONAL_BLOCKED_ON_ASM_002 and machine-checked. ASM-002 MUST be resolved before the first schema-creating migration is accepted or executed and before tenancy-sensitive implementation is finalized; a multi-tenant confirmation requires this contract to be revised and re-reviewed first.

database_roles.purpose: Executes reviewed migrations in the controlled release step only (ADR-0011).
database_roles.privileges: DDL on the TrustLens schema; never used by the request path.

SELECT/INSERT on OPS tables; column-level UPDATE only on declared mutable_columns/write_once_columns; no DELETE. On AUD: INSERT/SELECT on audit_event, audit_checkpoint, audit_checkpoint_signing_attempt; NO UPDATE or DELETE on any historical audit row; the only AUD UPDATE is the narrow column-level grant on audit_chain_head(last_chain_sequence, last_event_hash, updated_at) needed to advance the chain on append. This is not general AUD UPDATE and cannot rewrite prior events or hashes.

SELECT; UPDATE on cross-store state columns of cross_store_operation, evidence_item, evidence_derivative, input_envelope_record, evaluation (lease expiry -> FAILED_INFRASTRUCTURE only); INSERT on audit_event. Audit append uses the same narrow audit_chain_head UPDATE grant; no UPDATE/DELETE on historical audit rows.

DELETE / tombstone-minimization on GOVERNED_DELETION_ONLY tables, only within an authorized deletion_action; INSERT on audit_event; never on AUD history or NEVER-delete tables. Audit append uses the same narrow audit_chain_head UPDATE grant; no UPDATE/DELETE on historical audit rows.

principal_status.note: DATA-001 §5.1.1; MINIMIZED = governed personal-data minimization (residual rules OI-05)

case_grant_kind.note: DATA-001 §5.1.3; no administrator grant kind exists

storage_mode.note: Inline canonical text in OPS or externalised to EvidenceContentStore

canonical_json_version.note: WP2 §8.3 — the existing Phase-4 canonical JSON convention

evaluation_origin.note: DATA-001 §5.9 origin, finalised by WP2 (RETRY_AFTER_FAILURE closes INFO-2)

evaluation_failure_category.note: Safe categorical failure codes; never a classification

review_routing_basis.note: References to categorical DetectionResult facts only (FR-036)

adjudication_outcome.note: Persistence vocabulary v1; Phase 7 may extend additively

knowledge_governance_eligibility.note: Non-authoritative mirror of KNOW governance state (ADR-0013)

retention_policy_status.note: OI-05 OPEN — no duration or legal basis

deletion_action_state.note: OPS workflow state (INFO-1); accountability lives in AUD

audit_event_type.note: ADR-0010 §9 + ADR-0013 Decision 14 + ADR-0009/ARCH-004 §9.2 + ARCH-005 §11.4 + ARCH-006 §8; additive extension only

Feedback.deferred: Post-MVP (FR-064); non-authoritative; physical mapping deferred until the feedback capability is scheduled. Never auto-trains (SRS 5.5.8).

replay_material_set.description: Evaluation identity, timestamp, input_id and every write-once pin.
Exact governed input artifact (observations, indicator observations, evaluation_context) and its digest.
Pinned ENGINE_VERSION must be the executing engine.
Exact bundle by content_digest with manifest/component versions; the bundle bytes come from KNOW (PublishedBundleRepository) and are verified before use.
Exact Phase-4 sealed audit + replay snapshot; restored, never re-run.
External enrichment actually consumed: none may be consumed under current contracts (enforced); any future consumption is inside the governed artifact (RM-02).
Immutable stored DetectionResult and digest (comparison target).
Original evidence manifests for every source of the envelope.
Retained original bytes, re-hashed against content_sha256 before replay.
Derivatives that fed the envelope, with digests.
Normalized input envelope bytes and digest.

tables.name: principal_reference
tables.purpose: TrustLens reference to an authenticated human or workload actor. No credential material.

columns.name: external_issuer
columns.description: Validated IdP issuer (or workload identity issuer) — not a credential; NULL only after governed minimization.

columns.name: external_subject
columns.description: Validated subject claim — not a credential; may be personal data; NULL only after governed minimization.

unique.name: uq_principal_reference_external_identity
unique.purpose: One TrustLens principal per validated external identity.

checks.name: ck_principal_reference_identity_present
checks.rule: status = 'MINIMIZED' OR (external_issuer IS NOT NULL AND external_subject IS NOT NULL)
checks.purpose: Identity present unless minimized under governed policy (OI-05).

transition_guards: external_issuer/external_subject may change only to NULL, together with status MINIMIZED, by tl_deletion_executor under an authorized deletion_request (residual rules OI-05); no other identity change is permitted.

tenancy_sensitivity.reason: Global uniqueness of (issuer, subject) and a deployment-wide principal namespace assume a single tenant.

tables.name: role_assignment
tables.purpose: Grant of one of the five TrustLens roles; revocation is write-once.

unique.name: uq_role_assignment_active
unique.purpose: At most one active grant per principal and role.

tenancy_sensitivity.reason: Roles are deployment-global; a multi-tenant model would scope roles per tenant.

tables.name: case_access_grant
tables.purpose: Resource-level authorization context; deny by default; evidence-content access is a separate explicit permission.

columns.name: grant_kind
columns.description: OWNER or ASSIGNED_ANALYST; no administrator kind exists.

unique.name: uq_case_access_grant_single_owner
unique.purpose: Exactly one active OWNER grant per case.

checks.name: ck_case_access_grant_expiry_order
checks.rule: expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > effective_from

indexes.name: ix_case_access_grant_case
indexes.justification: Deletion enumeration and case access listing (includes revoked grants).

transition_guards: OWNER grant principal must equal case_record.owner_principal_id (constraint trigger).
ASSIGNED_ANALYST grantee must hold an active ANALYST role_assignment (constraint trigger).

tables.name: break_glass_grant
tables.purpose: Defined-not-implemented emergency content access: explicit reason, automatic expiry, mandatory post-event review.

columns.name: scope_case_record_id
columns.description: Soft reference to the case in scope (grant history must survive governed case deletion).

columns.name: scope_evidence_item_id
columns.description: Soft reference to the evidence item in scope (EVIDENCE_ITEM scope).

columns.name: reason_text
columns.description: Explicit reason; must not contain evidence content.

columns.name: expires_at
columns.description: Automatic expiry (maximum duration NOT YET SPECIFIED).

checks.name: ck_break_glass_reviewer_distinct
checks.rule: reviewed_by_principal_id IS NULL OR reviewed_by_principal_id <> principal_reference_id

soft_references.reason: Break-glass history must outlive governed case deletion.
Break-glass history must outlive governed evidence deletion.

tables.name: knowledge_change_reference
tables.purpose: Application-side SoD reference to a governed knowledge change (Git review remains the binding control; no rule content).

columns.name: change_ref
columns.description: External governed change identity (e.g. reviewed commit/merge reference).

columns.name: resulting_bundle_content_digest
columns.description: Bundle produced by the change, when known.

checks.name: ck_knowledge_change_sod
checks.rule: approved_by_principal_id IS NULL OR approved_by_principal_id <> authored_by_principal_id
checks.purpose: Author cannot approve their own change (ADR-0009 SoD, SRS 5.5.5).

tables.name: case_record
tables.purpose: Incident container and access/deletion root. Carries no verdict.

tables.name: case_note
tables.purpose: Governed note; edits are new revisions.

columns.name: note_text
columns.description: Free text; may quote evidence; never emitted to telemetry.

tables.name: submission
tables.purpose: One user submission act. Free-text/PII user context is carried in the ECS-stored input envelope, not here.

tables.name: evidence_item
tables.purpose: Evidence manifest. Original bytes live only in EvidenceContentStore; no global deduplication by digest.

columns.name: content_sha256
columns.description: SHA-256 of the exact original bytes, computed before the content write.

columns.name: byte_definition_version
columns.description: Version of the byte-definition contract that was hashed.

columns.name: source_channel_ref
columns.description: Governed channel term (dimensions CH-* or UNKNOWN).

columns.name: ecs_locator
columns.description: Opaque internal EvidenceContentStore locator; never a public/presigned URL; never authority.

columns.name: data_key_version_ref
columns.description: Versioned data-encryption key REFERENCE only (ARCH-004 §7.3); never key material.

columns.name: content_state
columns.description: Cross-store content state (WP2 §11); never FINALIZED unless bytes are durably stored and digest-verified.

columns.name: idempotency_key
columns.description: Idempotency key shared with the cross_store_operation that writes the content.

checks.name: ck_evidence_item_finalized_requires_verified
checks.rule: (content_state NOT IN ('CONTENT_STORED','INTEGRITY_VERIFIED','FINALIZED') OR (ecs_locator IS NOT NULL AND content_sha256 IS NOT NULL)) AND (content_state NOT IN ('INTEGRITY_VERIFIED','FINALIZED') OR verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (content_state <> 'FINALIZED' OR finalized_at IS NOT NULL)
checks.purpose: A row can never claim stored/verified/finalized content without a locator, digest and verification instant.

transition_guards: content_state transitions follow WP2 §11 state machine; FINALIZED is terminal except governed DELETION_PENDING/DELETED.

tables.name: evidence_derivative
tables.purpose: Derivative lineage manifest (normalized/OCR/redacted/preview/URL-observation records). Content bytes in ECS only.

columns.name: derivative_sha256
columns.description: SHA-256 of derivative bytes once stored.

columns.name: ecs_locator
columns.description: Opaque internal EvidenceContentStore locator; never a public/presigned URL; never authority.

columns.name: content_state
columns.description: Cross-store content state (WP2 §11); never FINALIZED unless bytes are durably stored and digest-verified.

columns.name: idempotency_key
columns.description: Idempotency key shared with the cross_store_operation that writes the content.

checks.name: ck_evidence_derivative_finalized_requires_verified
checks.rule: (content_state NOT IN ('CONTENT_STORED','INTEGRITY_VERIFIED','FINALIZED') OR (ecs_locator IS NOT NULL AND derivative_sha256 IS NOT NULL)) AND (content_state NOT IN ('INTEGRITY_VERIFIED','FINALIZED') OR verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (content_state <> 'FINALIZED' OR finalized_at IS NOT NULL)
checks.purpose: A row can never claim stored/verified/finalized content without a locator, digest and verification instant.

tables.name: input_envelope_record
tables.purpose: Manifest of one governed input envelope (input-envelope.schema.json). The envelope carries raw_text/normalized_text and user context, so its bytes are stored ONLY in ECS.

columns.name: envelope_sha256
columns.description: SHA-256 of the stored canonical envelope bytes.

columns.name: ecs_locator
columns.description: Opaque internal EvidenceContentStore locator; never a public/presigned URL; never authority.

columns.name: content_state
columns.description: Cross-store content state (WP2 §11); never FINALIZED unless bytes are durably stored and digest-verified.

columns.name: idempotency_key
columns.description: Idempotency key shared with the cross_store_operation that writes the content.

checks.name: ck_input_envelope_record_finalized_requires_verified
checks.rule: (content_state NOT IN ('CONTENT_STORED','INTEGRITY_VERIFIED','FINALIZED') OR (ecs_locator IS NOT NULL AND envelope_sha256 IS NOT NULL)) AND (content_state NOT IN ('INTEGRITY_VERIFIED','FINALIZED') OR verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (content_state <> 'FINALIZED' OR finalized_at IS NOT NULL)
checks.purpose: A row can never claim stored/verified/finalized content without a locator, digest and verification instant.

tables.name: input_envelope_source
tables.purpose: Lineage link from an envelope to the evidence items/derivatives of the same submission it was built from.

columns.name: envelope_attachment_id
columns.description: Envelope attachment_id mapped to this source.

transition_guards: Source evidence must belong to the envelope's submission (constraint trigger).

tables.name: governed_input_artifact
tables.purpose: The exact governed material consumed by ONE Phase-3 evaluation; strictly 1:1 with evaluation (WP1 LOW-1).

columns.name: evaluation_id
columns.description: The ONE evaluation that consumes this artifact (UNIQUE).

columns.name: input_envelope_record_id
columns.description: Envelope the observations were extracted from.

columns.name: input_id
columns.description: Governed input identifier; equals the envelope's.

columns.name: governed_artifact_digest
columns.description: Canonical SHA-256 of the exact artifact (Phase-4 integration digest).

columns.name: artifact_canonical_json
columns.description: Exact canonical JSON text of {observations, indicator_observations, evaluation_context} when INLINE.

columns.name: ecs_locator
columns.description: Opaque internal EvidenceContentStore locator; never a public/presigned URL; never authority.

unique.name: uq_governed_input_artifact_evaluation
unique.purpose: Each evaluation has at most one artifact and each artifact exactly one evaluation (1:1; WP1 LOW-1).

checks.name: ck_governed_input_artifact_storage
checks.rule: (storage_mode = 'INLINE' AND artifact_canonical_json IS NOT NULL AND ecs_locator IS NULL) OR (storage_mode = 'ECS' AND artifact_canonical_json IS NULL AND ecs_locator IS NOT NULL)

transition_guards: evaluation.status may not ENTER RUNNING unless this row exists (tg_evaluation_running_requires_artifact); REQUESTED -> FAILED_PRECONDITION requires no artifact.

tables.name: governed_observation_reference
tables.purpose: Query projection of observations inside a governed artifact (no spans or values). Must equal the pinned artifact.

tables.name: ai_extraction_provenance
tables.purpose: Sealed Phase-4 AIExtractionResult + AIReplaySnapshot for an evaluation where AI was USED. Attempt/fallback state lives on evaluation.

columns.name: validated_extraction_digest
columns.description: Digest of the retained validated extraction.

columns.name: ai_extraction_result_canonical_json
columns.description: Exact sealed AIExtractionResult (no raw model response).

columns.name: governed_artifact_digest
columns.description: Digest of the exact consumed governed artifact.

unique.name: uq_ai_extraction_provenance_evaluation
unique.purpose: At most one AI provenance per evaluation.

transition_guards: Row allowed only when evaluation.ai_used is true (constraint trigger).

tables.name: evaluation
tables.purpose: One deterministic execution instance and its immutable pins. Never references a mutable 'current/latest' knowledge pointer.

columns.name: evaluation_id
columns.description: Evaluation identity; its canonical text form is passed to Phase 3 and echoed in DetectionResult.evaluation_id.

columns.name: execution_lease_expires_at
columns.description: Lease of the executing replica; lease length NOT YET SPECIFIED (P6-WP6).

columns.name: execution_fence_token
columns.description: Opaque fencing token of the current execution owner (UUIDv4). Set on entering RUNNING; cleared in the same compare-and-set that fences the evaluation into any terminal non-success state. Completion must present the current token; time alone is never trusted.

jsonb_contract.validation_owner: Application persistence adapter validates against the promoted detection-result schema before write

unique.name: uq_evaluation_fence
unique.purpose: Target of the detection_result fencing foreign key: a result row can only reference the live (evaluation, fence token) pair.

checks.name: ck_evaluation_pins_after_start
checks.rule: status IN ('REQUESTED','FAILED_PRECONDITION') OR (bundle_content_digest IS NOT NULL AND bundle_version IS NOT NULL AND manifest_schema_version IS NOT NULL AND engine_version IS NOT NULL AND result_contract_version IS NOT NULL AND evaluation_profile_id IS NOT NULL AND extraction_confidence_gate IS NOT NULL AND risk_matrix_id IS NOT NULL AND confidence_policy_id IS NOT NULL AND action_policy_version IS NOT NULL AND component_versions IS NOT NULL AND evaluation_timestamp IS NOT NULL AND input_support_status IS NOT NULL AND language IS NOT NULL AND script IS NOT NULL)
checks.purpose: Every evaluation that started is pinned to one exact bundle/engine/profile/support context.

checks.name: ck_evaluation_completed
checks.rule: status <> 'COMPLETED' OR (completed_at IS NOT NULL AND result_computed_at IS NOT NULL AND replay_material_digest IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_evaluation_failed
checks.rule: (status IN ('FAILED_PRECONDITION','FAILED_INTEGRITY','FAILED_INFRASTRUCTURE')) = (failed_at IS NOT NULL AND failure_category IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_evaluation_origin_predecessor
checks.purpose: Lineage required for every non-initial evaluation.

checks.name: ck_evaluation_ai_consistency
checks.rule: (NOT ai_attempted OR ai_extraction_enabled) AND (NOT ai_used OR (ai_attempted AND ai_fallback_reason IS NULL))
checks.purpose: AI state consistent with Phase-4 semantics.

checks.name: ck_evaluation_not_self_predecessor
checks.rule: predecessor_evaluation_id IS NULL OR predecessor_evaluation_id <> evaluation_id

checks.name: ck_evaluation_fence_held_while_executing
checks.rule: status NOT IN ('RUNNING','RESULT_COMPUTED_PERSISTENCE_PENDING') OR execution_fence_token IS NOT NULL
checks.purpose: An executing evaluation always has exactly one current fence token.

checks.name: ck_evaluation_fence_cleared_when_failed
checks.rule: status NOT IN ('FAILED_PRECONDITION','FAILED_INTEGRITY','FAILED_INFRASTRUCTURE') OR execution_fence_token IS NULL
checks.purpose: A fenced/failed evaluation has no live token, so no result can reference it (P6-WP2 MEDIUM-1).

indexes.name: ix_evaluation_bundle_digest
indexes.justification: Which evaluations used an exact (e.g. withdrawn) bundle (ADR-0013 case A).

indexes.name: ix_evaluation_in_flight
indexes.justification: Lease sweeper for lost in-memory results (INFO-2).

transition_guards: Allowed transitions: REQUESTED->RUNNING|FAILED_PRECONDITION; RUNNING->RESULT_COMPUTED_PERSISTENCE_PENDING|COMPLETED|FAILED_INTEGRITY|FAILED_INFRASTRUCTURE; RESULT_COMPUTED_PERSISTENCE_PENDING->COMPLETED|FAILED_INFRASTRUCTURE; terminal states never change.
AI columns are mutable only while status is REQUESTED or RUNNING.
A FAILED_INFRASTRUCTURE evaluation can never later become COMPLETED; a retry is a NEW evaluation (origin RETRY_AFTER_FAILURE).
Lease renewal and completion are compare-and-set on execution_fence_token; a stale worker whose token was cleared matches zero rows and must ROLLBACK.

constraint_triggers.name: tg_evaluation_transition_guard
constraint_triggers.rule: Only declared transitions; terminal states (COMPLETED, FAILED_*) never change; write-once pins never change once set.

constraint_triggers.name: tg_evaluation_running_requires_artifact
constraint_triggers.rule: NEW.status = 'RUNNING' AND OLD.status <> 'RUNNING' requires a governed_input_artifact row with evaluation_id = NEW.evaluation_id.
constraint_triggers.purpose: An evaluation may not ENTER RUNNING without its exact governed input artifact; REQUESTED -> FAILED_PRECONDITION needs none (P6-WP2 LOW-2).

constraint_triggers.name: tg_evaluation_completed_requires_result
constraint_triggers.rule: status = 'COMPLETED' requires EXISTS (detection_result WHERE evaluation_id = NEW.evaluation_id).
constraint_triggers.purpose: Commit-time coherence: COMPLETED implies a durable result.

tables.name: detection_result
tables.purpose: The exact canonical completed DetectionResult emitted by Phase 3, plus immutable query projections. Never updated.

columns.name: execution_fence_token
columns.description: Fence token of the execution that wrote this result; must equal the evaluation's live token at insert (binding FK).

columns.name: result_digest
columns.description: SHA-256 over TRUSTLENS_CANONICAL_JSON_V1 bytes of the emitted result.

columns.name: result_canonical_json
columns.description: Exact canonical JSON of DetectionResult.as_dict() when INLINE.

columns.name: ecs_locator
columns.description: Opaque internal EvidenceContentStore locator; never a public/presigned URL; never authority.

jsonb_contract.validation_owner: Application persistence adapter validates against the promoted detection-result schema before write

unique.name: uq_detection_result_evaluation_digest
unique.purpose: Composite-FK target so adjudications/reports pin the exact result.

checks.name: ck_detection_result_storage
checks.rule: (storage_mode = 'INLINE' AND result_canonical_json IS NOT NULL AND ecs_locator IS NULL) OR (storage_mode = 'ECS' AND result_canonical_json IS NULL AND ecs_locator IS NOT NULL)

transition_guards: Projections must equal the canonical document (write-path assertion + verification job); the document is authoritative.
Pins must equal the evaluation's write-once pins (constraint trigger).

constraint_triggers.name: tg_detection_result_insert_guard
constraint_triggers.rule: Lock the owning evaluation row (FOR UPDATE); require evaluation.status IN ('RUNNING','RESULT_COMPUTED_PERSISTENCE_PENDING') AND evaluation.execution_fence_token = NEW.execution_fence_token; otherwise raise.
constraint_triggers.purpose: No result can be inserted for a fenced, failed, or not-yet-running evaluation (P6-WP2 MEDIUM-1).

constraint_triggers.name: tg_detection_result_requires_completed
constraint_triggers.rule: At commit, the owning evaluation.status = 'COMPLETED' for NEW.evaluation_id; otherwise the transaction fails and the result row does not persist.
constraint_triggers.purpose: Commit-time coherence: a durable result exists only under a COMPLETED evaluation.

constraint_triggers.name: tg_detection_result_immutable
constraint_triggers.rule: UPDATE always raises; DELETE only by tl_deletion_executor within an authorized deletion_action.

tables.name: rule_result_projection
tables.purpose: Per-rule decomposition projected from rule_results for explanation/query; never authoritative.

tables.name: user_correction
tables.purpose: User correction of an extraction error leading to a NEW evaluation; never mutates the corrected one.

unique.name: uq_user_correction_resulting
unique.purpose: A new evaluation results from at most one correction.

checks.name: ck_user_correction_distinct
checks.rule: resulting_evaluation_id IS NULL OR resulting_evaluation_id <> corrected_evaluation_id
checks.purpose: Correction never re-targets the same evaluation.

tables.name: review_routing_state
tables.purpose: Human-review workflow over categorical result facts; never changes the result.

columns.name: routing_policy_version
columns.description: Routing policy version (policy expression owned by P6-WP3/Phase 7).

checks.name: ck_review_routing_in_review_assigned
checks.rule: queue_state <> 'IN_REVIEW' OR assigned_analyst_principal_id IS NOT NULL

transition_guards: Assigned analyst must hold an active ASSIGNED_ANALYST case_access_grant on the case (constraint trigger).

tables.name: analyst_adjudication
tables.purpose: Human judgement pinned to an exact result digest; separate from and never modifying the DetectionResult.
transition_guards: Adjudicator must hold ANALYST role and an active ASSIGNED_ANALYST grant on the case (constraint trigger).

tables.name: report_bundle_record
tables.purpose: Report revision identity + reproducibility manifest. Report bytes live in ECS. Regeneration is conditional on retained inputs (LOW-3).

columns.name: reproduction_of_report_bundle_record_id
columns.description: Revision this row attempts to reproduce.

columns.name: generation_instant
columns.description: Pinned generation instant (never re-read on regeneration).

columns.name: report_manifest_canonical_json
columns.description: Canonical manifest (identifiers and digests only; no content).

columns.name: ecs_locator
columns.description: Opaque internal EvidenceContentStore locator; never a public/presigned URL; never authority.

checks.name: ck_report_bundle_generated
checks.rule: generation_outcome <> 'GENERATED' OR (report_digest IS NOT NULL AND ecs_locator IS NOT NULL)
checks.purpose: Generated reports have bytes and a digest.

checks.name: ck_report_bundle_unavailable
checks.rule: generation_outcome <> 'REGENERATION_UNAVAILABLE' OR (reproduction_of_report_bundle_record_id IS NOT NULL AND report_digest IS NULL AND ecs_locator IS NULL AND generation_failure_category IS NOT NULL)
checks.purpose: Unavailable regeneration produces no bytes and names its reason.

tables.name: report_evaluation_pin
tables.purpose: Exact evaluation/result pins of a report revision.

columns.name: ai_config_ref
columns.description: Pinned AI config reference, if AI used.

indexes.name: ix_report_evaluation_pin_evaluation
indexes.justification: Deletion enumeration: which reports depend on an evaluation.

tables.name: report_evidence_pin
tables.purpose: Exact evidence/derivative pins of a report revision.

tables.name: replay_execution
tables.purpose: One replay request and its write-once outcome. Verification only; never a new authoritative result.

checks.name: ck_replay_execution_capable_outcomes
checks.purpose: Only a capable replay can MATCH/MISMATCH; unavailable material is an explicit failure.

checks.name: ck_replay_execution_match_digest
checks.rule: outcome NOT IN ('MATCH','MISMATCH') OR replayed_result_digest IS NOT NULL

checks.name: ck_replay_execution_missing_listed
checks.rule: replay_capability_state IS NULL OR replay_capability_state = 'REPLAY_CAPABLE' OR missing_material_kinds IS NOT NULL
checks.purpose: Unavailable replay names the missing material.

constraint_triggers.name: tg_replay_execution_requires_completed
constraint_triggers.rule: Target evaluation.status = 'COMPLETED' (which by the commit invariants implies its DetectionResult exists).
constraint_triggers.purpose: Only a durably COMPLETED evaluation's result can be replayed (P6-WP2 MEDIUM-1 consumer safety).

tables.name: external_enrichment_result
tables.purpose: Advisory, untrusted provider observation (future). Never a DetectionResult input under current contracts.

columns.name: consumed_in_governed_artifact
columns.description: Must be false under current contracts.

checks.name: ck_external_enrichment_failure_not_clean
checks.rule: status = 'SUCCEEDED' OR (reputation_result = 'NOT_EVALUATED' AND allowlist_result = 'NOT_EVALUATED' AND domain_matches_claimed_brand = 'UNKNOWN')

checks.name: ck_external_enrichment_not_consumed
checks.purpose: No enrichment enters a DetectionResult until a governed contract (INT-001/ADR-0012) permits it.

tables.name: knowledge_bundle_reference
tables.purpose: Reference to one exact published bundle. Holds NO rule/indicator/taxonomy content.

columns.name: bundle_version
columns.description: Bundle version (not an identity on its own).

jsonb_contract.validation_owner: Knowledge activation adapter validates against the bundle manifest schema

columns.name: eligibility_source_ref
columns.description: Governed source of the eligibility observation.

tables.name: knowledge_activation_record
tables.purpose: Append-only activation/rollback/withdrawal-remediation history (ADR-0013 Decision 10).

checks.name: ck_knowledge_activation_active_validated
checks.purpose: Never ACTIVE without validation and required authenticity.

transition_guards: ACTIVE/ROLLBACK targets must not be WITHDRAWN in knowledge_bundle_reference at decision time (application guard + audit).

tables.name: knowledge_deployment_state
tables.purpose: Current per-deployment active-bundle pointer. Mutable and NEVER used as evaluation provenance.

tables.name: retention_policy_reference
tables.purpose: Retention class + policy version reference. Carries NO duration, expiry interval or legal basis (OI-05 OPEN).

columns.name: policy_status
columns.description: UNRESOLVED_OI05 until a governed policy exists.

columns.name: retention_basis_ref
columns.description: Governed basis reference — only once OI-05 is decided.

tenancy_sensitivity.reason: Retention classes are deployment-global; per-tenant policy would change this.

tables.name: deletion_request

completion_protocol.purpose: Fenced, commit-coherent durable completion of an evaluation (P6-WP2 MEDIUM-1).
completion_transaction: SELECT evaluation FOR UPDATE WHERE evaluation_id = :e AND status IN ('RUNNING','RESULT_COMPUTED_PERSISTENCE_PENDING') AND execution_fence_token = :fence -- zero rows => ROLLBACK (fenced or not eligible)
INSERT detection_result (..., execution_fence_token = :fence) -- insert guard + binding FK re-check eligibility and token
INSERT rule_result_projection rows; INSERT audit_event rows

UPDATE evaluation SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at, replay_material_digest WHERE evaluation_id = :e AND status IN ('RUNNING','RESULT_COMPUTED_PERSISTENCE_PENDING') AND execution_fence_token = :fence -- must affect exactly 1 row, else ROLLBACK
COMMIT -- deferred invariants: result exists <=> evaluation COMPLETED
fence_transaction: UPDATE evaluation SET status = 'FAILED_INFRASTRUCTURE', failure_category = 'RESULT_DURABILITY_UNCONFIRMED', failed_at = now(), execution_fence_token = NULL WHERE evaluation_id = :e AND status IN ('RUNNING','RESULT_COMPUTED_PERSISTENCE_PENDING') AND execution_fence_token = :observed_token AND execution_lease_expires_at < now() -- zero rows => nothing to fence; the binding FK makes this fail if a result already committed
completion_protocol.notes: Row locks on the evaluation serialise completion and fencing; whichever commits first wins and the other matches zero rows. A retry is always a NEW evaluation (origin RETRY_AFTER_FAILURE); a stale worker can neither complete, resurrect, nor touch the retry.
